subject: POC readiness playbook & procurement runway
messages:
From: Claire Hsu <c.hsu@medallion.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Miguel Torres <m.torres@medallion.ai>, Leah Park <leah.park@medallion.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap & primary gaps

Jonas / team — thanks for a productive call this afternoon. Quick recap from our side and the open items we need to land to move to a scoped POC: 

1) Objectives (we want the POC to validate):
- Reduce latency for chart summarization to <300ms 95th for 1k prompts/day workload
- Maintain HIPAA-safe data handling (no model access to raw PHI)
- Demonstrate cost per inference at scale (baseline vs. Redwood-config)

2) Key internal stakeholders (who we will involve):
- Rajiv Menon — Economic buyer (CPO, Medallion)
- Leah Park — InfoSec (will own risk & controls review)
- Miguel Torres — Procurement lead (quote & contract)
- Claire Hsu — Product lead / POC sponsor (me)

3) Primary gaps / asks from Redwood before we commit to dates:
- Security evidence: SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram, and a short write-up on on-prem vs. hosted controls
- Proposed MAP (milestones, owners, acceptance criteria) for a 6–8 week POC
- Preliminary pricing band and SLA targets for Dedicated vs. Hosted options

Attached: Medallion-RFP-criteria.docx (our internal scoring rubric)

Proposed immediate next step: can you share a one-page MAP by EOD tomorrow with milestones and a candidate timeline? Miguel will need an initial procurement window by next Wednesday (6/2).

Thanks — Claire

--
Claire Hsu | Head of Data Products | Medallion Health
Mobile: +1 415-555-0199
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Claire Hsu <c.hsu@medallion.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & primary gaps

Claire — appreciate the clear recap and rubric. Attached is a one-page MAP skeleton that aligns to your scoring doc and splits the POC into three milestone gates: kickoff & infra validation, feature validation (sampling & latency), and acceptance & handoff. High-level timeline below (can compress to 6 weeks if we run in parallel):

Milestone A — Kickoff & Security Validation (week 0–1)
- Deliverables: data flow diagram, SOC 2 summary, ingress/egress controls doc
- Owner: Jonas (Redwood) + Leah (Medallion)
- Acceptance: Leah signs off on controls list

Milestone B — Feature & Latency Validation (week 2–5)
- Deliverables: baseline perf report, sample prompts (you provide safe subset), cost-per-token estimate by config
- Owner: Monica (Redwood SE) + Claire (Medallion PD)
- Acceptance: 95th percentile latency <300ms OR documented tradeoff with cost runbook

Milestone C — Procurement & Contracting (week 4–6)
- Deliverables: draft SOW, pricing band, draft security addendum
- Owner: Ben (Redwood Sales Ops) + Miguel (Procurement)
- Acceptance: PO or signed MSA term sheet

Attachments: redwood-map-template.xlsx (editable MAP, milestones column prefilled)

Action items for tomorrow:
- We will upload the security evidence pack and a short hosted vs dedicated risk note.
- Ben will prepare a pricing band and a sample SOW stub for Miguel.

I’ll follow up with a shared Drive folder and a HubSpot deal update (linked). If this looks right I’ll propose times for a 30-minute kickoff next week.

Best —
Jonas
--
Jonas Weber | Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0144
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Claire Hsu <c.hsu@medallion.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T17:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP skeleton + quick ops notes

Claire / team — adding a couple of operational clarifications from the SE side that we think will help accelerate Milestone A/B: 

- Data flow: for the POC we recommend a masked payload pattern (PII removed before send) + short-term KV cache disabled for auditability; this keeps the test simple while Leah runs controls.
- Test harness: we can deliver a containerized harness to replay 1k prompts/day and capture latencies (no production data required).
- Resources: if you want a guaranteed 95th <300ms we recommend a small Dedicated pool for the POC (1–2 GPUs) — Hosted can meet it but requires stricter batching which may affect samples.

Attached: SaaS-terms-summary.pdf (summary of our standard MSA points and optional security addendum)

I can join the kickoff and run the perf work; propose we pencil in Mon 6/7 for the kickoff demo window if Miguel confirms procurement availability.

Thanks — Monica
--
Monica Patel | Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0127
From: Claire Hsu <c.hsu@medallion.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Miguel Torres <m.torres@medallion.ai>, Leah Park <leah.park@medallion.ai>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@medallion.ai>
Date: 2027-05-31T09:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP skeleton + quick ops notes

Thanks Jonas / Monica — this is helpful. A few clarifications and an initial procurement window: 

- Security evidence: Leah confirmed SOC 2 + short risk summary will be sufficient to scope the security review. Leah, I will loop you into Redwood's evidence pack once available.
- Procurement: Miguel says initial approval window is 6/7–6/11 (internal calendar review). We need a draft SOW and a ballpark number by 6/2 for his review.
- Acceptance criteria: Rajiv wants a one-line ROI check included for the MAP (expected cost delta vs. baseline + expected latency improvement).

On Mon, May 30, 2027 at 4:05 PM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Claire — appreciate the clear recap and rubric. Attached is a one-page MAP skeleton that aligns to your scoring doc and splits the POC into three milestone gates: kickoff & infra validation, feature validation (sampling & latency), and acceptance & handoff.

We can commit to sending the MAP and the pricing band by EOD Monday (6/2). Miguel — if that timeline works we can lock a kickoff for 6/7.

Claire

Date: 2027-06-01T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP skeleton + quick ops notes — confirmed next steps

Claire / Miguel / Leah — thanks. Confirming next steps and owners: 

1) Security evidence pack (SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram, hosting controls) — owner: Jonas (deliver by 2027-06-02 EOD)
2) Editable MAP (milestones, owners, acceptance criteria) — owner: Jonas (redwood-map-template.xlsx attached)
3) Pricing band + draft SOW stub — owner: Ben (deliver by 2027-06-02 morning)
4) SE perf harness & recommended config (Dedicated vs Hosted) — owner: Monica (deliver by 2027-06-03)
5) Procurement review window — Miguel to confirm PO timeline (6/7–6/11 tentative)

I've created a shared Drive folder and updated the HubSpot deal (link below). I will also open a DocuSign powerform for the MSA stub after we align on pricing. Proposed kickoff: Tue 2027-06-08 10:00–10:30 PT (30m). If that time doesn't work please propose two alternatives.
